name: ITS_embedding_bge_1000
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 (config.json max_position_embeddings 512). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-10-31. A MultipleNegativesRankingLoss fine-tune of BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5, same BERT-large encoder and 1024-d output, 0.335B. Single-row evidence: card table '| Model | Hit rate / Accuracy@5 |' gives 0.961744 fine-tuned vs 0.916370 stock baseline on 1,124 ITS Global validation queries. Thin: one private validation set, no MTEB, and the card itself says the result should not be read as a general benchmark. Licence MIT, repo created 2026-09-14.

benchmarks.name: ITS validation Accuracy@5
benchmarks.config: Card table '| Model | Hit rate / Accuracy@5 |': 'Fine-tuned ITS BGE' 0.961744 vs 'Stock BGE baseline' 0.916370 (x100). 1,124 queries from the ITS Global knowledge hub validation set. Author states the result is specific to that set and retrieval config.
